summary: Iteration 34 — i18n FR→EN feature fully validated. Backend 8/8 pass (pytest_iter34_i18n.xml): login demo.stores@casaneo.app OK, /api/dashboard 200, /api/cleaning-schedule 200, POST /api/reservations with guest_lang='en' persists and is returned by GET /api/reservations, POST /api/public/site/mhpimmo/request with lang='en' → reservation stored with guest_lang='en' (verified via Mongo since public site owner ≠ demo). Frontend 5/5 pass on mobile viewport 390x844: (T1) Login screen renders in EN ("Manage your vacation rentals", "Bookings, calendar, seasonal rates and AI assistant", "Continue with Google", "Log in with email and password", "New? Create an account — free 14-day trial") because Playwright locale=en-US triggers auto→EN. Home dashboard EN: drawer items Home/Inbox/Bookings/Calendar/Properties/Due today/Settings/Help/Log out; KPI cards Occupancy rate / Monthly revenue / Properties / Upcoming; sections Payments to track, Statements to send, Due today with Checkouts/Arrivals/Cleanings to do/Interventions/Key handovers/Security deposits. (T2) /settings/appearance shows section 'LANGUE / LANGUAGE' with 3 chips (testIDs lang-auto/lang-fr/lang-en). Clicking lang-fr reloads and switches everything to French (Apparence/THÈME/Automatique/Clair/Sombre, Accueil/Réservations/Calendrier/Logements/À faire aujourd'hui/Paramètres/Aide/Déconnexion, Taux d'occupation/Revenus du mois/Logements/À venir, Bonjour !/Par quoi commençons-nous aujourd'hui ?, Paiements à suivre, Relevés à envoyer). (T3) /reservation-form displays 'Guest language (automatic emails)' with chips Français/English (testIDs guest-lang-fr / guest-lang-en); clicking guest-lang-en toggles the active chip. Backend persistence of guest_lang='en' via POST /api/reservations verified in backend tests. (T4) /book/mhpimmo shows lang-toggle pill top-right; initial state EN ("Book direct, no middleman / 24 accommodations availables / from 55€ / night / 1 bd / 2 guests"), clicking reloads and switches to FR ("Réservez en direct, sans intermédiaire / 24 hébergements disponibles / dès 55€ / nuit / 1 ch. / 2 pers."). (T5+T6 backend) POST /api/public/site/{slug}/request lang='en' persists guest_lang='en' in mongo (verified). All test-created reservations were deleted. No emails were sent to non-delivered addresses. No .env or metro.config.js modified.

critical_code_review_comments: src/i18n/patch.ts monkey-patches Text.render / TextInput.render / Alert.alert globally with a __i18n idempotency flag — clean approach, no per-screen edits needed and no memory leak.

src/i18n/index.ts normalizes strings with NFC + whitespace collapse before lookup — robust for accented FR keys. Regex RULES handle common dynamic patterns (n nuits / voyageurs / jours / logements / photos / J-N).
app/settings/appearance.tsx correctly persists langPref via AsyncStorage and triggers window.location.reload() on web — no state left behind. testIDs lang-auto/lang-fr/lang-en all present.
components/LangToggle.tsx uses fixed 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)' pill background — good contrast independent of theme; testID='lang-toggle' present; reload on web after setLangPref.
reservation-form.tsx line 300 payload includes guest_lang: form.guest_lang → confirmed persisted end-to-end via backend test.
backend/core.py _guest_lang() safely defaults to 'fr' when missing; ReservationIn.guest_lang default='fr'; _public_request maps payload.lang → guest_lang. Good defensive coding.
seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral test reservations were created (one owner-authenticated via /api/reservations, one via public site POST) and both were DELETED (owner API + direct mongo cleanup). No properties or other data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n feature is production-ready. Key testIDs: appearance screen → lang-auto/lang-fr/lang-en; reservation-form → guest-lang-fr/guest-lang-en; public site → lang-toggle. Playwright locale=en-US → app starts in EN by default (auto pref). To restart in FR programmatically, set AsyncStorage 'app_lang_pref'='fr' or click lang-fr in /settings/appearance. Backend persistence: reservations collection has guest_lang field ('fr'|'en'); default is 'fr'; public POST /api/public/site/{slug}/request uses payload.lang → guest_lang. Cleanup: test reservations were removed but if any escape use mongo db.reservations.deleteMany({guest_name: /^TEST /}). Two minor copy issues to fix (see design_issues) — non-blocking. Backend test suite: /app/backend/tests/test_i18n_guest_lang.py is reusable for regression.
